upstream_expectation: TYPE="valid" (XML 1.1): the document is accepted and valid. Its external entity ibm/xml-1.1/valid/P03/ibm03v09.ent is `<?xml version="1.1"` followed by U+2028 and `?>`: a text declaration with no encoding declaration and a line separator inside it.
our_expectation: the document is rejected with a fatal error: the text declaration is not well formed
rationale: XML 1.1 production [77] is `TextDecl ::= '<?xml' VersionInfo? EncodingDecl S? '?>'`. The encoding declaration is mandatory in a text declaration, and this entity has none. XML 1.1 section 2.11 states: "it is a fatal error to use [NEL, #x2028] within the XML declaration or text declaration". The entity breaks both rules, and U+2028 is not white space (production [3] S) in a text declaration. The suite's own description of the case says "(This test is questionable)". Accepting the document would mean accepting what the Recommendation forbids. The test runs; the runner counts it as local-override on the XML 1.1 line and on the validating line, and reports a STALE override (a failure) if it starts to pass.
